claim_boundary: Runs SAM only for GT-clean frame-0 anchor extraction on multi-object videos.
Does not propagate recovery trajectories after frame 0.
Does not compute DI percentile ranks or a DI score.
Does not select a hard set.
Does not construct final DEV or TEST.
Does not evaluate fresh DEV or TEST.
Single-object cases are retained with explicit structural no-competitor status and no fabricated cosine.
